title: A Question About Fasting

questions.question: In the fourth year of King Darius, the people of Bethel sent men to entreat the favor of the Lord, asking if they should continue to weep and fast in the...
questions.explanation: Zechariah 7:3 (ESV): "Should I weep and abstain in the fifth month, as I have done for so many years?"

questions.question: Then the word of the Lord of hosts came to me: "Say to all the people of the land and the priests, 'When you fasted and mourned in the fifth month and in the seventh, for these seventy years, was it for... that you fasted?'"
questions.explanation: Zechariah 7:5 (ESV): "was it for me that you fasted?"

questions.question: "And when you eat and when you drink, do you not eat for yourselves and drink for...?"
questions.explanation: Zechariah 7:6 (ESV): "do you not eat for yourselves and drink for yourselves?"

questions.question: "Thus says the Lord of hosts, Render true judgments, show kindness and mercy to one another, do not oppress the widow, the fatherless, the sojourner, or the..."
questions.explanation: Zechariah 7:10 (ESV): "do not oppress the widow, the fatherless, the sojourner, or the poor,"

questions.question: "...and let none of you devise evil against another in your..."
questions.explanation: Zechariah 7:10 (ESV): "and let none of you devise evil against another in your heart."

questions.question: "But they refused to pay attention and turned a... and stopped their ears that they might not hear."
questions.explanation: Zechariah 7:11 (ESV): "But they refused to pay attention and turned a stubborn shoulder and stopped their ears that they might not hear."

questions.question: What did they make their hearts like, lest they should hear the law and the words of the Lord?
questions.explanation: Zechariah 7:12 (ESV): "They made their hearts diamond-hard lest they should hear the law"

questions.question: Because their hearts were hard, what came from the Lord of hosts?
questions.explanation: Zechariah 7:12 (ESV): "Therefore great anger came from the Lord of hosts."

questions.question: "As I called, and they would not hear, so they called, and I would not..."
questions.explanation: Zechariah 7:13 (ESV): "'As I called, and they would not hear, so they called, and I would not hear,' says the Lord of hosts,"

questions.question: "...and I scattered them with a whirlwind among all the nations that they had not known. Thus the land they left was..."
questions.explanation: Zechariah 7:14 (ESV): "Thus the land they left was desolate, so that no one went to and fro,"

questions.question: "...and the pleasant land was made..."
questions.explanation: Zechariah 7:14 (ESV): "and the pleasant land was made desolate."

questions.question: Through whom did the Lord send His words by His Spirit?
questions.explanation: Zechariah 7:12 (ESV): "and the words that the Lord of hosts had sent by his Spirit through the former prophets."

questions.question: Besides the fifth month, in which other month had they fasted and mourned for seventy years?
questions.explanation: Zechariah 7:5 (ESV): "When you fasted and mourned in the fifth month and in the seventh, for these seventy years,"

questions.question: Who sent men to entreat the favor of the Lord?
questions.explanation: Zechariah 7:2 (ESV): "Now the people of Bethel had sent Sharezer and Regem-melech and their men to entreat the favor of the Lord,"

questions.question: What did the Lord want them to render instead of just fasting?
questions.explanation: Zechariah 7:9 (ESV): "Render true judgments, show kindness and mercy to one another,"

key_verse_text: "Thus says the Lord of hosts, Render true judgments, show kindness and mercy to one another, do not oppress the widow, the fatherless, the sojourner, or the poor, and let none of you devise evil against another in your heart."
